title: Betrayed Young Lady, What is your Wish?

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Due to the schemes of the Dark Elf and the Goblin Lady, Nephi Nela was thought to have been crystallized. However, she suddenly appeared before Kanon when she found herself in a difficult situation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダークエルフとゴブリンレディの謀略により、
結晶化したかと思われたネフィ＝ネラ。
しかし彼女は、
窮地に陥ったカノンの前に姿を現すのであった。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What is going on right here?! Nephy! I saw you turn into crystal, right there--*cough* It is foul play to show up again like this before I even had the chance to land the finishing blow--*cough*...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どどどっ、
どういうことですのこれはっ！？
ネフィ！　
アナタは確かに、
そこで結晶に
ぅげふっ！
トドメを刺す前に化けて出るなんて
卑怯ですわよ
ぐぉっほごほ……！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: You chirp a lot for someone with such a shallow wound. What do the commonfolk call it... "Piichiku Paachiku", was it? The meaningless chirping of a fool is hardly pleasing to my ears.
text_block_list.orig_text:
浅からん傷でよく囀る也。
世俗の云いで、
『ぴぃちくぱぁちく』だったか喃？
虚けの鳥鳴きは差して
快くもありんせん。

text_block_list.name: Dark Elf
text_block_list.text: Why...?! I am certain that my spell had activated...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜですか……！
私の呪術は
間違いなく発動したはず……！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Your curse is certainly showing its power. Your scheme has reached me - on my thin skin, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
汝の呪いは、
確かに威を示して候。
策謀は届きたる也──
わっちの薄皮一枚に。

text_block_list.name: Goblin Lady
text_block_list.text: Eh... There's a hole in the floor?! Could this woman have just cut off the surface... and avoided being trapped by turning into liquid?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ──
床に、
穴！？
こいつまさか、
表面だけ切り離して……
液体化して避けたってのっ！？

text_block_list.name: Dark Elf
text_block_list.text: ...However, the barrier is still active. There is a limit to how much you can separate yourself from your body. We still have the advantage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ですが
結界はまだ発動しています。
自身の切り離しにも限界があるでしょう。
依然として
優位なのはこちらです！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Hmm. In that case, I shall also return to the robber what is due. ...Mia.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム。
然らば此方も
強盗返しと参ろうぞ。
──ミーア。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Yeeees! Barrier... rebooted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい～！
結界、
再起動～！

text_block_list.name: Dark Elf
text_block_list.text: ...! You've overwritten my barrier even more in such a short time. It seems you have some excellent subordinates. Oh dear... It seems we have no choice but to run right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！　
この短時間で
私の結界をさらに上書きしましたか。
優秀な部下がいるようですね。
やれやれ……
ここは一度
退くしかないようです。

text_block_list.name: Goblin Lady
text_block_list.text: But, but! We've come this far--
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもでもっ！
ここまで来て──

text_block_list.name: Dark Elf
text_block_list.text: ...Behave yourself and obey me.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──おとなしく従いなさい。

text_block_list.name: Goblin Lady
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: You truly believe your exit is granted?
text_block_list.orig_text: 退き口が叶うと？

text_block_list.name: Dark Elf
text_block_list.text: Well... that'd be up to you, Princess. HAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
それは媛次第かと──
ハァッ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Mm? Where...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ム？　
何処を……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Get down.
text_block_list.orig_text: 伏せい。

text_block_list.name: Dark Elf
text_block_list.text: Heheh! To think you'd need to cover for such an incompetent fool... Tough for you, ain't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
フフッ！
そんな能無しまでかばう必要があるとは、
大変ですね──？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: It was a diversion disguised as an attack. Good grief, I should have not let my guard down around a thief.
text_block_list.orig_text:
攻撃と見せかけた目くらまし。
誠、
油断のならぬ賊よ喃。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Just now... what was that all about...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のは、
どういうことですの……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: はて？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Why did you protect me?! I was just about to murder you not a second ago!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんであたくしをかばったんですの！？
あたくしはついさっきまで
アナタをブチ砕いてやろうとしてましたのよ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Korokorokoro. Is it not obvious? Because you are my dear Lord Kishi's Slave. If that were not the case, I would have chopped off your head already and offered it as a warning on the ramparts of my citadel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──コロコロ。
決まっておろう？　
汝が騎士殿の奴隷であるからよ。
然もなくば、
今ごろ素っ首掻き切り
胸壁に晒していた所。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Your life will continue unaffected thanks to that. Be deeply grateful to your Master, Lord Kishi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その命が変わらず在ること。
汝の主人の騎士殿に、
深く
深く
感謝せいよ。

text_block_list.name: カノン
text_block_list.text:
……あと一歩のところで
また失敗して……
……よりによって
ネフィ＝ネラに
かばわれて……
……
あの馬ボーンの
奴隷だったから、
命が
ある……？
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あと一歩のところで
また失敗して……
……よりによって
ネフィ＝ネラに
かばわれて……
……
あの馬ボーンの
奴隷だったから、
命が
ある……？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: ...That is just.....hilarious....
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あまりにも……
滑
稽、
ですわ……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Bear witness. Your Master has come for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見やれ。
汝の主が迎えに来て候。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: There you are, you traitorous drill-hair! Wait for me right there! I'm coming to beat you to a pulp!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いましたねこんの裏切り縦ロール！
そこになおりなさいっ、
私がボッコボコのギッタギタにしてやりますから！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Kanon-san...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
カノンさん……？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あたくしは……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Hey...? What's wrong with her? Her eyes look completely lifeless...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと……？
どうしちゃったんですか？
目から光が消えちゃってますけど……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Korokorokoro. What, this? No need for you to worry, my dear otherwordly visitor. I just gave her a bit of a harsher scolding -- a departure from my usual methods.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──コロコロコロ。
なに、
案ずるに能わず、
異世界の御客人。
少々熱めの灸を据えただけでありんす──
日頃と違う仕儀で喃。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Wh-What on earth could have happened to lead to this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
一体何があったらここまで……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much for your concern...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご心配……
ありがとうございます、
ですわ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's disgusting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ、
気持ち悪っ！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful that you would come for such a wretched, worthless thing as myself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなみじめったらしく使えねぇあたくしを迎えに来ていただき、
心より感謝いたします……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Lowborn... No, I mean, dear Master. From now on, I will serve you as your Slave for the rest of my life...
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬ボーン……
ではなく、
ご主人様。
これからあたくしは、
ご主人様の奴隷として
一生お仕えいたしますわ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: This is terrible... Hmm, even if I want to get back at her for what she just did, I won't feel any sense of satisfaction...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはひどい……
う～ん、
こんなんじゃさっきの腹いせするにしても、
手応えが……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Ahh... To betray my dear Master at that time... What an outrageous thing... I am willing to accept any punishment...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
その節はご主人様を裏切るなんて……
とんでもないことを……
あたくし、
どのような罰でも受け入れる所存ですわ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...A-Anyway, let's save what's going on with her for later. Umm, Nephi Nela-san, right? Have you seen Rei-sama anywhere? She was taken by that dark elf...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……と、
とりあえずコレは後回し。
あの～、
ネフィ＝ネラさんですよね。
レイ様を見ませんでしたかっ？
ダークエルフたちにさらわれてしまって……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: O'new guest who is familiar with Lord Kishi and has come to visit my Gio Gehenna. I beg your pardon. It was my failing that allowed those thieves to flee.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿と共に
このジオ・ゲヘナを新たに訪れてくださったお客人。
相済みませぬ。
賊の逐電を許すは
わっちの不徳。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: That also is my fault... Everything... Aaaall of it, is my fault...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それもあたくしのせいですわ……
ぜー
んぶ、
ぜー
んぶ
あたくしが悪いんですの……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't come here to blame anyone. I'm here to help Rei-sama with my own hands. So there's no need for any of you to apologize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誰かのせいにするために来たんじゃありません。
私は、
私の手でレイ様を助けるために動いています。
だから、
気にする必要はありません。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. To be this resolute in the midst of chaos while wearing such an outfit... is this what it means to be an "Idol"? How elegant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フム。
惑いの渦中にあれど
綺羅を纏うと──
これが
『あいどる』でござんすか。
雅なる哉。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: I am the complete opposite of elegance; I am a vulgar and lowly slave... Far from being fancy, I am more suited to wearing rags.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたくしは雅とは真反対、
俗で卑しい奴隷ですわ……
綺羅どころか、
襤褸を纏うのがお似合いの。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Even when she's depressed, she simply can't shut up, this one...
text_block_list.orig_text: 落ち込んだら落ち込んだでうるさいですねこの人……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: We will also investigate the whereabouts of those thieves. Lord Kishi, Lady Tsumugi... It appears there is no need for me to ask.
text_block_list.orig_text:
賊奴等の行方は
此方でも探り申す。
騎士殿、
ツムギ殿は……
尋ねるまでもありんせんな。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Of course, we're just going to keep chasing them as we did! So, umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
このままアイツらを追います！
それで、
その……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...Kanon-san, too. Could we take her with us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……カノンさんも、
連れていって
いいですか？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: And why is that? Judging from the situation, this one has once again turned her "drills" against you. To bring her along would yield loss, not gain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
其は何故に？
状況を見るに、
此奴はまたも軽い掌を
『どりる』したのであろ？
同道させたとて、
損は有れど益は無し。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... how should I put it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは
そうなんですけど……
なんというか……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: ...I am just going to end up failing again... There is nothing a useless Manticore like me could do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あたくしなんて、
また失敗するだけですわ……
ド無能マンティコアなんかには、
何もできやしねえんですのよ……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...I see. If that is what you claim, I shall not stop you. My Lord Kishi, please take care of the matter with Kanon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……成程喃。
そう申されては、
此方も引き留めはすまいよ。
騎士殿、
主としてカノン奴の事、
何卒よしなに。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Come on, let’s go! What good is a noble lady who spends all her time looking down?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
行きますよ！
高貴な令嬢が下ばっか向いててどうするんですか！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: ...As you command. I am far from being noble, I am of lowly nobility, so I will obey Master and Lady Tsumugi...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おおせのままに。
高貴どころか
低貴なあたくしは、
ご主人様とツムギ様に従いますわ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: *sigh*
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Just as Kanon's long-cherished wish to defeat Nephi Nela was about to come to fruition, everything fell apart. Her life was saved by her hated enemy, and when she was told that the reason she was still alive was thanks to {0}, her heart broke.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネフィ＝ネラ打倒の念願を目前に、
すべてが瓦解したカノン。
その命を憎き仇敵に救われ、
生かされている理由も
{0}のおかげと言われ、
その心は折れてしまう──
